## [1.3.0](https://github.com/SledgeSune/morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-11)

### ✨ New Features

* **Waze:** Add "Keep Waze alive" patch ([1fe1f9e](https://github.com/SledgeSune/morphe-patches/commit/1fe1f9e68d0d9a9ac68ff0aa32e3f657efc35b2b))
* **Waze:** Add "Remove ads" patch ([402806b](https://github.com/SledgeSune/morphe-patches/commit/402806b1601d3ca91e87242981804a1891261326))

patches.name: Disable tracking
patches.description: Stops usage analytics from being sent to Firebase, Mixpanel, Singular and Facebook.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes all ads (banners, native, interstitial and app-open ads), the same way the "No Ads" purchase does. Other Premium features stay locked.

patches.name: Hide upgrade prompts
patches.description: Skips the "Go Pro" screen after sign-up and hides Premium sales banners, the Premium sheet after SMS, Premium promo notifications and upgrade banners in the call history.

patches.name: Keep navigation bar
patches.description: Stops "aggressive mode" from hiding the phone's navigation bar.

patches.name: Skip app promotions
patches.description: Removes the "free gift" card after calls and banners promoting other apps.

patches.name: Disable reroute auto-accept
patches.description: Removes the countdown from the "faster route found" prompt while driving, so the route only changes when you tap the button yourself.

patches.name: Keep Waze alive
patches.description: Lets Waze stay open in the background longer before it closes itself (Waze's "background timeout", normally set by Waze's servers).

options.description: How long Waze may stay in the background before it closes itself. Longer uses more battery if you leave Waze open.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored pins on the map, sponsored search results, the full-screen ad when stopped and promotional launch screens.

patches.name: Trip history
patches.description: Records how long each drive took and how far you drove. Shows it next to each place under Recent in "Where to?", and lists all drives under "Trip history" in the side menu.
